Name: Farmhouse Variants
Author: fireredlily
Description:
[b]Change Your Farmhouse Style[/b]
[size=3]Farmhands shouldn't be the only ones who get to redesign their building style. Choose from one of the skins based on the farmhouse cabin styles or a new style based on the Joja Corporation! This mod uses Content Patcher and the base game Buildings skin system to add new styles that can be freely changed (as long as Robin isn't working on a building already).[/size]

[b]How To Use[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Visit Robin's shop and choose the [b]Construct Farm Buildings[/b] option and choose to [b]Paint[/b] a building.[/size]
[*][size=3]Select the [b]Farmhouse[/b] to change the appearance of the farmhouse. If on the second upgrade, you will need to click the House icon in the paint menu to change the appearance.[/size]
[*][size=3]After the second upgrade of the farmhouse, also gain the ability to paint the walls, trim, or roof of your chosen farmhouse style.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Known Issues
[list]
[*][size=3]The smoke from the chimney may appear in the wrong place after switching the building skin. This is a purely visual issue and reloading the save will update the chimney smoke position to be in the correct place![/size]
[/list][/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: The initial release! Adds 8 new farmhouse building skins that can be accessed through Robin's "paint building" option under the Construct Farm Buildings menu.

Manifest.Description: Adds new CP building skins to the farmhouse.
